profiles.description: Grows ABC Insurance's intermediated distribution by scanning the market for emerging distribution models, developing business concepts and hypotheses for new channels, and maintaining the prioritized distribution channel innovation roadmap. Owns broker and agency recruitment discovery meetings, profiles competitor distribution strategies and channel moves, and captures event leads for handoff to sales. Partners on channel investment business cases and ROI, supports controlled pilots of new channels, and delivers product and underwriting appetite training to producers. Maintains the broker pipeline and call reports, representing market appetite and product positioning externally while partnering with underwriters to progress opportunities.

sources.title: Insurance Business Development Manager Job Description Template (Template.net)
Business Development Specialist - Arrowhead General Insurance Agency

profiles.notes: Packet skews toward channel innovation/strategy work (roadmap, new-channel pilots) on top of classic broker BD; sources describe the classic broker-relationship core, which matches the recruitment, competitive-intelligence, and pipeline responsibilities.

profiles.description: Bridges business and technology across the carrier's operations, product delivery, and distribution value streams: elicits and documents requirements for policy, billing, and claims system changes and translates them into user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows. Directly configures product coverages and rating tables in the policy system, implements underwriting rules and referral logic, and maintains CRM views, templates, and lead-routing integrations for field sales and marketing. Leads current-state process mapping and cycle-time waste quantification, designs future-state redesign blueprints, and supports pilots that measure realized benefits. Also supports UAT planning, test case review, defect triage, and requirement walkthrough sign-offs with business stakeholders.

sources.title: Business Systems Analyst (Insurance P&C) Jobs in the United States (Jobright)

profiles.notes: Priors (Delivery / Individual Contributor) confirmed by research. Packet includes hands-on policy-system and CRM configuration ownership, which sits at the technical end of the BSA spectrum described in job postings for Guidewire/Duck Creek-style platforms.

profiles.description: Forecasts and manages technology capacity for the carrier's infrastructure: predicts resource saturation from utilization trends, raises proactive capacity and pre-failure work items, and contributes to predicting component failure from degradation signals and tracking prediction accuracy and prevented incidents. Forecasts infrastructure capacity demand for peak insurance cycles such as renewals, billing runs, and CAT events, validates capacity headroom assumptions for major releases and platform migrations, and approves scaling thresholds and burst capacity arrangements with platform teams. Also participates in workforce management capacity planning, helping build staffing schedules aligned to demand peaks and rebalancing coverage against actuals. Represents business demand signals in quarterly infrastructure capacity planning reviews and prioritizes capacity investment requests.
profiles.notes: Vocab stretch: no Infrastructure/Technology family in roleFamilyVocab; Engineering is the closest fit for an Infrastructure & Networks role. Packet mixes infrastructure capacity/predictive-failure work (Owner) with contact-center-style workforce staffing tasks (Participant); sources treat IT capacity planning and workforce management as distinct disciplines, but the Participant relation on staffing tasks is consistent with a supporting analytics role.

profiles.description: Owns the carrier's capital adequacy and solvency management cycle: compiles available and required capital by legal entity, calculates authorized control level RBC ratios across risk categories and against internal thresholds, and projects the multi-year capital position under base and stress scenarios. Prepares the ORSA summary report and capital adequacy narrative, tracks legal entity solvency status against minimum capital requirements, and reports liquidity stress test results to ALCO and capital management. Also governs capital expenditure, tracking capex spend against approved authorizations, and contributes cost-of-capital charges for internal transfer pricing. Coordinates capital plans with finance, actuarial, risk, and reinsurance stakeholders and recommends capital actions, contingency triggers, and allocation changes.

sources.title: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (NAIC Insurance Topics)

classificationFlags.rationale: Death-certificate good-order validation is a claims intake task; NAIC RBC/ORSA material scopes capital management to solvency monitoring, capital adequacy, and stress projection, not claims document verification.

profiles.notes: Packet lists the Claims value stream as Lead and includes a claims good-order deliverable, which conflicts with every researched definition of a capital management function; flagged the specific task, and the Claims Lead linkage looks like a lineage artifact worth review.

profiles.description: Runs the carrier's economic capital and catastrophe-informed capital analytics: blends multi-vendor catastrophe model views into consensus loss estimates, compiles man-made and emerging peril results for the risk committee, and tests zonal accumulations against risk appetite limits, issuing accumulation steering recommendations to underwriting. Quantifies net-of-reinsurance PML and capital relief, simulates candidate reinsurance program structures, and maps the reinsurance program into the capital model risk feed to support ERM capital model integration and net retention risk appetite setting. Supports regulatory capital and RBC computation, stress and scenario testing, and group filings such as the Form F enterprise risk report. Interprets model results for solvency, rating agency, and planning use, coordinating capital assumptions with finance, risk, and reinsurance teams.

sources.title: The Benefits of Economic Capital Modeling (Huggins Actuarial Services)

profiles.notes: Sources confirm ECM work spans underwriting, catastrophe, reinsurance credit, and capital adequacy, matching the packet's deliverable set. Deliverables overlap heavily with the CAT Modeler role (natural catastrophe execution, accumulation management, reinsurance optimization); the capital-model integration and RBC/stress deliverables are what distinguish this role.

profiles.description: Applies and reconciles incoming money across the carrier's life, annuity, and retirement books: processes lockbox and ACH/EFT receipt files, matches incoming payments to open premium invoices, applies received premium to policies, and investigates and clears unapplied cash in suspense. Reconciles applied cash to daily bank deposits, confirms reinstatement payments, processes return premium on cancellations, and reconciles incoming 1035 exchange and transfer funds to contracts. Handles payment reversals, NSF returns, and chargebacks, matches agency bill statements to remittances, and escalates aged suspense items and recurring application errors to billing leadership. The packet also attaches this role to adjacent policy-accounting transactions such as renewal worklists, policy loan and surrender disbursements, and plan/participant money-in processing.

sources.title: Cash Application Specialist Job Description (Velvet Jobs)

classificationFlags.item: Generate The Renewal Worklist From Upcoming Expirations
classificationFlags.rationale: Researched cash application job descriptions (Velvet Jobs, Jooble) scope the role to payment application, suspense resolution, and reconciliation, not renewal pipeline generation, which is a policy-operations task.

profiles.notes: Priors (Operations & Service / Individual Contributor) confirmed. Packet/source tension: the packet gives this role 60 owner tasks across 29 deliverables including contract issue, subaccount rebalancing, and plan installation — far broader than the payment-application scope every researched source describes; only the clearest contradiction was flagged, but the deliverable breadth deserves review.

profiles.description: Prepares and runs catastrophe models across ABC Insurance's property-exposed portfolios: extracts and consolidates policy exposure schedules into modeling format, geocodes insured locations and enriches them with peril hazard data, and validates construction, occupancy, and secondary modifier completeness. Runs catastrophe models to derive OEP, AEP, and PML curves and to estimate treaty loss distributions for reinsurance pricing and structure optimization, reconciling modeled output against prior-year and vendor benchmarks. Manages catastrophe accumulation by aggregating total insured value by catastrophe zone and comparing zonal accumulation against approved capacity limits. Supports assumed-exposure ingestion checks, post-event loss estimation, and stress and scenario testing, translating catastrophe analytics into portfolio insight for underwriting and reinsurance decisions.
profiles.notes: Vocab note: no dedicated catastrophe/exposure family exists; Actuarial matches the org home (Actuarial > Catastrophe Modeling) and the discipline's placement at carriers. Zurich's posting confirms this as a mid-level individual contributor with data-quality leadership but no people management.

profiles.description: Leads the carrier's catastrophe exposure management discipline: prepares and cleanses exposure data, runs natural catastrophe and man-made cat models, and analyzes PML, AAL, and accumulation results to keep peril concentrations within appetite. Communicates peril accumulations and exposure shifts to senior management and uses modeled results to inform reinsurance purchasing and capital decisions. Industry sources place this role at the manager tier of the exposure management career path, overseeing the data-quality, model-execution, and accumulation-reporting work performed by CAT modeling analysts. At this carrier the role currently has no wired value streams or tasks, so scope is inferred from its four stated responsibilities.

sources.title: Catastrophe & Exposure Management Jobs (Gravitas Recruitment Group)

proposedOrgUnit.rationale: Its responsibilities (exposure data prep, cat model runs, PML/AAL/accumulation analysis) are the management layer of the work homed in Actuarial > Catastrophe Modeling, where the CAT Modeler already sits.

profiles.notes: Prior disagreement: priors say roleFamily Reinsurance and roleLevel Individual Contributor. Research supports Actuarial (the work is cat modeling/exposure analytics that informs reinsurance rather than reinsurance placement) and Manager (Gravitas lists Exposure Management Manager above analyst/senior-analyst tiers, and the title itself is Manager). Confidence is low because the packet has zero value streams, tasks, and deliverables — the role is not yet wired into the graph.

profiles.description: Administers the carrier's ceded reinsurance program data and reporting: tracks actual ceded premium and recoveries against plan for mid-year steering, reconciles ceded premium against treaty proportions, and reconciles ceded premium and loss bordereaux to the general ledger. Owns Schedule F statutory compilation by reinsurer, including the provision for overdue and disputed recoverables, and verifies reinsurer financial strength ratings against minimum thresholds to maintain the approved-reinsurer list and credit watchlist. Validates reinsurer collateral and credit support, generates reinsurance recovery positions, and maintains treaty documentation, supporting operational-controls self-assessments and regulatory compliance monitoring. Coordinates with the reinsurance manager, underwriting, actuarial, finance, and claims on cessions and recoveries data.

profiles.description: Coordinates organizational change activities across the carrier's delivery, HR, and technology value streams: supports business readiness planning by coordinating end-user training and process documentation updates, coordinates transition communications and consultation steps for workforce transitions, and validates inter-change dependencies and bundling constraints for release scope decisions. Maintains the change impact inventory across transformation initiatives, coordinates change readiness assessments with business leads ahead of major releases, and aligns communications, training, and go-live support into a single adoption calendar. Tracks adoption metrics, surfaces resistance hotspots to change managers, and schedules change champion network activities and stakeholder engagement sessions. A supporting, coordination-focused role — every wired task is Participant-level.

The role is homed in HR & Talent > Learning & Change while its family is Delivery — defensible given its release/business-readiness task wiring, but HR would also fit; kept the prior. Confidence medium because only 3 tasks are wired.

profiles.description: Runs the operational backbone of ABC Insurance's distribution channels: coordinates onboarding of agencies and producers, generating producer agreements from approved contract templates, collecting executed agreements and required documentation, creating producer master records and assigning producer codes. Supports producer license verification, records verification outcomes, clears licensing holds, and reconciles appointment status against the active license inventory for ongoing producer compliance monitoring. Participates in distribution operating model design — documenting end-to-end roles across channels, defining producer servicing tiers, and configuring distribution workflows in the portal and CRM — plus territory assignments and KPI/governance cadence definition. Also maintains producer hierarchies and book-of-business assignments, monitors licensing and appointment renewals, and resolves producer data and commission routing issues.

profiles.description: Leads the actuarial function at ABC Insurance as its senior financial-risk executive: approves and authorizes finalized assumption sets, reserve ranges for reporting use, and recommended reinsurance structures for placement. Chairs actuarial model governance, presenting governance status for committee approval, and certifies the annual actuarial professional compliance attestation under Actuarial Standards of Practice. Owns actuarial planning, budgeting, and resource management — preparing and approving the department operating budget — and presents the actuarial report to the board committee. Participates in mortality/longevity and lapse/policyholder-behavior experience studies that feed assumption recommendations, and advises executives on profitability, reserve adequacy, and risk trends across pricing, reserving, and capital.

sources.title: What Makes a Chief Actuary Truly Effective? (American Academy of Actuaries)

profiles.notes: Packet ownership pattern (approvals, governance, budget, board reporting) matches the Academy's characterization of the chief actuary as a strategic executive; Participant relations on experience-study drafting correctly leave technical production to the reserving/pricing teams.

profiles.description: Owns the internal audit function end to end at ABC Insurance, consistent with the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards: allocates audit hours to the annual risk-based plan and secures audit committee approval of it. Supervises engagement execution — performing supervisory review and sign-off of workpapers — assigns severity and overall engagement ratings, agrees management action plans and target dates with auditees, and compiles and issues final audit reports. Tracks findings remediation to closure in the remediation tracker and reports remediation status to the audit committee. Runs the Quality Assurance & Improvement Programme, conducting periodic internal self-assessments and coordinating the external quality assessment, while managing internal audit governance and stakeholder relationships including external auditors and regulators.

sources.title: Chief Audit Executive: Role & Responsibilities Guide (Eduyush)

profiles.notes: Priors (Audit / Executive, IIA definition) fully confirmed. Packet's 13 owner tasks map one-to-one onto the IIA-described CAE duties: risk-based plan, committee approval, engagement supervision, ratings/reporting, remediation tracking, and QAIP.

profiles.description: Sets claims strategy, reserving discipline, and service standards for ABC Insurance's claims organization, ensuring outcomes are fair, timely, and financially sound. Owns catastrophe event activation — declaring the event and assigning CAT codes to affected claims — and directs litigation posture, defining defense theory and litigation budgets with counsel and documenting release terms and authorizing settlement payments in pre-trial negotiations. Approves major settlement authority, escalation handling, and claims policy changes, and reviews severity trends, leakage, litigation posture, and vendor performance. Coordinates with legal, underwriting, SIU, and finance on material claims issues.
